about: Track tags (version 7): a train's tag and a stop's tag that are no names, and a tag at the last stop, which the train does not leave.
problems: train "1": the track tag must not start or end with a space or contain a control character
train "1", stop 2 "S": the track tag must not start or end with a space or contain a control character
train "1", stop 3 "B": is the last stop, which the train does not leave, so it has no track tag
